description: The Singapore Department of Statistics (SingStat) publishes the Census of Population 2020 tables, alongside earlier censuses and General Household Surveys, through SingStat Table Builder, which has a public developer API with an OpenAPI specification. A Table Builder search read today returned 27 Census of Population 2020 tables among 534 household and population tables, with 22 from the 2010 census, 26 from 2000 and 23 from the General Household Survey 2025. Examples include resident households by planning area and type of dwelling (table 17574) and resident population by planning area or subzone and type of dwelling (17562). Table 17574 gives, for Singapore and each planning area of the Urban Redevelopment Authority's Master Plan 2019, households in HDB flats by room count, condominiums and other apartments, landed properties and others: 1,372,559 resident households in total, 1,080,088 of them in HDB dwellings; it was last updated on 18 June 2021. Coverage: Singapore, by planning area and subzone; census every 10 years with household surveys between. Format and access: tables through the Table Builder web tool and JSON API, plus downloadable files; free. Licence: datasets on the SingStat website are under the Singapore Open Data Licence, per its terms of use. Caveats: only the table list and one table were read, so the other census 2020 tables were not checked; dwelling type is the only housing variable in the table read. Simulation uses: household counts by dwelling type and planning area for demand, exposure and evacuation planning. Related records: the Singapore HDB resale prices (data-singapore-hdb-resale-flat-prices) and Virtual Singapore (platform-virtual-singapore).
